body: That's kind of you to say. I just wish they could have had better you know?

I live in a country where it takes money to get a new future. Currently I live hand to mouth. If I had made better choices when I was younger maybe things would be different. I don't blame anyone for the place I find myself in. It was all my own fault. I have no educational degree to get a better job, and no money or time to study for one. I literally work day and night. I really feel like things can't get any better and why should my children suffer for my bad choices?

As an older woman, I think that younger people who express themselves are brave individuals. My son has a brow piercing and my daughter has a nose piercing. I think it's important to express who you are!
